newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start mixed as rates, expiry weigh.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start mixed as rates, expiry weigh.

text.p: Leading stocks opened mixed on Thursday as hopes of a short-term push to the psychologiaclly important 4,000 level continued to recede, traders said.
Modest profit-taking on Wall Street is likely to set the tone for trading in the London market.
U.S. interest rate concerns and caution ahead of Friday's expiry of FTSE 100 and 250 futures and options are set to remain to the fore and cap activity.
After opening lower, the FTSE 100 reversed the early fall to show a modest rise of 1.8 points to 3,957.5 by 0745 GMT.
